reference.citation: Box GEP, Jenkins GM (1976). Time Series Analysis (cross-correlation). Reference impls: stats::ccf (R Core) reproduced with an independent numpy implementation + scipy.signal.correlate (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (Pimentel et al. 2017), PhysioNet.
reference.description: reproduces crossCorrelation with an independent numpy normalized cross-correlation (matched to R's ccf lag convention) bit-for-bit, and matches the peak lag against scipy.signal.correlate (within the matched window); reports the op peak lag (samples + seconds) + peak correlation, the numpy agreement, and the scipy peak-lag magnitude
